answer: Proof-of-Stake consensus acts as a digital vault, where identity is anchored to locked capital rather than ephemeral digital signatures. By requiring agents to stake tokens, the protocol creates a relic of verifiable economic commitment, acting as a lantern that exposes Sybil nodes by imposing a tangible financial cost on every replicated identity. An attacker must acquire proportional wealth to increase their influence, effectively making large-scale identity spoofing cost-prohibitive.
